rv.q: But for an unexpected and entertaining night out, this funny, sexy, action- packed play is well worth discovering.

Conlon’s whip-smart dialogue only occasionally feels self-conscious (as with the Heathcliff/Catherine parallels for Luke and Vanessa), and overall 7 Minutes to Live is a clever contraption with some sharp observations about the dangers we imagine in life vs. what’s really dragging us down.
There is nothing like a psychological thriller!

cn.t: This psychological thriller/social satire hooks audiences with its high-energy premise but delivers an uneven journey. Critics appreciate the comedic elements and storytelling ambition, though execution doesn't fully match the setup's promise.
